claim: For every integer \(q\ge1\) and all \(m,n\ge3\), the directed successor cycles \(D_m,D_n\) are indistinguishable by first-order sentences of quantifier rank at most \(q\) exactly when the corresponding undirected cycles \(C_m,C_n\) are; equivalently, the size cutoff is \(3\) at rank one, \(4\) at rank two, and \(2^{q-1}+3\) for every \(q\ge3\).
scientific_limitations_integrity: Relational successor language only; cycle sizes \(m,n\ge3\). The lower-bound transfer is quantifier-free; the upper bound uses an order-preserving gap strategy. No independent audit or external validation has been performed.
title: Orientation-Invariant Quantifier-Rank Profile of Finite Cycles
